news.title: Investor sentiment deteriorates as stock falls 19%
news.body: After last week's 19% share price decline to ₹58.62, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 60.6x. Average trailing P/E is 19x in the Trade Distributors industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 244% over the past three years.

news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: Following the recent departure of a director, there is only 1 independent director on the board. The company's board is composed of: 1 independent director. 2 non-independent directors. Non Executive Independent Women Director Saumya Varma was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2025. The company's minority of independent directors is a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: Stratmont Industries Limited Announces Resignation of Mr. Chinmoy Kumar Guha as Independent Director and from the Board Committees, Effective February 20, 2026
news.body: Stratmont Industries Limited announced the Board of Directors of the Company in its Meeting held on 20 February, 2026, Took note of resignation of Mr. Chinmoy Kumar Guha, as the Independent Director of the Company as well as from the Board Committees due to personal reasons, with effect from the close of business hours on 20 February, 2026. Mr. Chinmoy Kumar Guha has confirmed that there are no material reasons for his resignation other than those mentioned in her resignation letter.

news.title: New minor risk - Dividend sustainability
news.body: The company has a short dividend paying track record. Less than a year of continuous dividend payments. Dividend yield: 0.3% This is considered a minor risk. For dividend focussed investors, companies that have not established a long-term track record of consistently maintaining or growing dividends are less attractive than those companies that have a long track record. Those that have a long track record have proven their underlying business is stable enough to consistently maintain or grow the dividend and that the company considers maintaining the dividend to be one of its priorities. For dividend paying companies, any reduction in the dividend can significantly impact the share price. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.55 (vs ₹0.04 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.55 (up from ₹0.04 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹417.8m (up 90% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹15.7m (up ₹14.7m from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 3.8% (up from 0.5% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 45% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 67% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: Stratmont Industries Limited (BSE:530495) acquired 99% stake in Stratmont Coal And Commodity Private Limited.
news.body:
Stratmont Industries Limited (BSE:530495) acquired 99% stake in Stratmont Coal And Commodity Private Limited on December 9, 2025. Consequently, Stratmont Coal And Commodity Private Limited has now become a subsidiary of the company.

Stratmont Industries Limited (BSE:530495) completed the acquisition of 99% stake in Stratmont Coal And Commodity Private Limited on December 9, 2025.
